title: Queryable attributes for lus-fts-siteaccesslocation-2 collection
description: This lists the attributes which can be filtered on and their types for lus-fts-siteaccesslocation-2 collection.

osid.description: Primary identifier for the feature. The OSID is a Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) and requires no centralised authority to ensure uniqueness. Note that the same OSID can occur in more than one feature type when a single feature is represented multiple times in the OS NGD.

toid.description: Topographic identifier (TOID) of the feature, as published in the OS MasterMap suite of products.

access_mode.description: A description of the method(s) of access normally utilised at the Site Access Location (for example, Pedestrian).

access_purpose.description: A description of the principal access function at the Site Access Location (for example, Private or Public).
